season.evidence: Search: a 2013 circuit report says rock is snow-free from mid/late June to late July; moat trouble builds after May on the glacier side; a guided Green Glacier trip was done in early August 2025. Logged summits of the peak: Aug 11, Jul 4, Jun 2, Sep 1.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 2022 summit with no logged route or report; track holds only a start/end pair beginning ~6.8 km from the Elbow Lake pin, so the approach is not ours, and it cannot tell North Face, West Face or SE Ridge apart (all within 6 m of the single summit pin).
